web_sources.tdjacobs.com: Evolutionary Astrology (EA): Pluto/SN/SN-ruler/NN for soul's journey. No synastry; natal reveals relationship patterns/karma.
web_sources.siddhantika.com: Synastry overview: Planet roles in overlays/aspects.

core_principles.synastry: Overlay one chart on another: Planets in houses/aspects between charts. Reveals chemistry, friction, growth.
core_principles.composite: Midpoint chart: Relationship as third entity (Sun=purpose, Moon=emotional rhythm).
core_principles.humanistic: Mutual transformation, not prediction. Karma (past) + dharma (potential).
core_principles.evolutionary: Soul's multi-life journey; relationships resolve karma.
core_principles.compatibility: Not harmony alone: Communication, empathy, shared values, growth potential.

foundational_axes.asc_desc: Self/other: Jimmy's Asc in Jenny's 9th → philosophical expansion; Desc in 3rd → mental rapport.
foundational_axes.mc_ic: Public/private: MC in 7th → power couple; IC in 1st → emotional foundation.

house_clusters.house_3: Communication: Sun/Mercury/Chiron/Eris → addictive talk, healing wounds.
house_clusters.house_6: Daily work: Mars/Saturn/Nemesis/Nessus → discipline, karmic battles.

aspects.favorable: Sun/Moon/Venus trines/sextiles/conjunctions → harmony. Mars/Venus any aspect → attraction.
aspects.challenging: Saturn hard to luminaries → restriction. Uranus → disruption.

techniques.natal_prep: Sun/Moon/Asc elements; Mercury style; 7th house ruler.

counseling_guide.ethics: No absent-party charts sans permission. Neutral, astrological basis.

examples.jimmy_jenny: Fated union: Axes/clusters/Royal Stars → transformation via values/work/philosophy.

MasterRelationshipAstrologyCompendium.synthesis: All sources converge: Synastry reveals dynamics (overlays/aspects/clusters); evolutionary lens adds soul purpose (Pluto/Nodes). Humanistic focus: Growth over fate. Practical: Natal first, then interaction, then relationship entity.

metadata.subject: Jim S.
metadata.progression_key_time: 0:00 UT on 2012-04-25 corresponds to 0:00:30 UT on 1974-05-19
metadata.notes: All progressed planet positions are for 2012-04-25, using the reference place Bellaire, OH. Progressed angles are approximated from sidereal time shift; for exact angles, software is required.

progressed_angles_approximated.method: Sidereal time increased by 2h29m58s (from birth 6:54:10 to progression 9:24:08). Approx 1° advance of Asc per 4 min, so ~37.5° forward. Starting Asc 10° Libra, add 37.5° = 17° Scorpio? Wait, must recalc: 2h29m58s = 149.97 minutes / 4 = 37.49°. 10° Libra + 37.49° = 17° Scorpio (since 10° Lib to 0° Sco = 20°, remainder 17.49°). So progressed Asc ~ 17°30' Scorpio. Similarly MC advances same ~37.5° from 12° Cancer = 19° Leo (12° Can to 0° Leo = 18°, remainder 19.5°). Progr. MC ~ 19°30' Leo.
progressed_angles_approximated.interpretation: Progressed Asc in Scorpio: intense, magnetic self-presentation, undergoing deep personal transformation. Progr. MC in Leo: career focus on creativity, recognition, leadership; public image becomes more dramatic and proud.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Taurus brings steady, practical self-expression. Focus on material security, sensory pleasures, and patience.
interpretation.house_meaning: 8th house rules shared resources, intimacy, death/rebirth, and psychological transformation.
interpretation.combined: Identity tied to joint finances, inheritance, or deep personal change. A slow, determined approach to letting go and rebuilding. Likely major financial or emotional turning point.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Aries Moon is impulsive, emotionally direct, needs independence and immediate action.
interpretation.house_meaning: 7th house rules one-on-one relationships, partnerships, contracts, open enemies.
interpretation.combined: Emotional needs are expressed through initiating action in partnerships. May feel impatient with a partner, needing to start fresh or assert independence within a relationship. Arguments are quick and cleansing.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Gemini Mercury is curious, adaptable, communicative, likes multiple streams of information.
interpretation.house_meaning: 9th house rules higher education, long-distance travel, philosophy, law, publishing.
interpretation.combined: Thinking expands through learning, travel, or spiritual seeking. Likely reading, writing, or teaching about big-picture ideas. Restless mind seeks meaning.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Aries Venus loves passionately, directly, and competitively. Values excitement and spontaneity in love.
interpretation.house_meaning: 7th house (same as Moon) – partnerships, marriage, clients.
interpretation.combined: Love style becomes assertive and adventurous. May pursue a partner actively or enjoy playful competition in relationships. Attraction to confident, independent people.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Cancer Mars acts defensively, protectively, and emotionally. Driven by home, family, and security needs.
interpretation.house_meaning: 10th house – career, public reputation, authority figures.
interpretation.combined: Action in career is motivated by protecting home or family. Could be a workplace confrontation rooted in emotional needs, or a career change to spend more time at home. Ambition with a nurturing twist.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Pisces Jupiter expands through compassion, spirituality, art, and surrender. Generous but prone to escapism.
interpretation.house_meaning: 6th house – daily work, health, routines, service.
interpretation.combined: Growth and luck come through helping others, healing work, or creative daily practices. Risk of overindulgence (eating, substances) or vague boundaries at work. Ideal for a service-oriented job.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Saturn in Cancer creates structure around home, family, and emotional security. May feel restricted or responsible for family.
interpretation.house_meaning: 9th house – higher learning, travel, law, religion.
interpretation.combined: Serious commitments to education, publishing, or foreign travel. Could involve family responsibilities that limit travel, or a delayed academic degree. Teaching or legal matters related to real estate/home.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Uranus in Libra brings sudden changes, rebellion, or innovation in relationships, justice, and aesthetics.
interpretation.combined: Unexpected shifts in self-image or how one presents to the world. May suddenly change hairstyle, clothing, or relationship status. Feels unpredictable to others and oneself. Desire for freedom in partnerships.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Neptune in Sagittarius dissolves rigid beliefs, inspires spiritual travel, and confuses meaning.
interpretation.combined: Financial confusion or idealistic spending on travel, education, or charity. May have unrealistic expectations about income. Alternatively, a spiritual or artistic approach to earning money. Values become hazy.

interpretation.sign_meaning: Pluto in Libra transforms relationships, justice systems, and social balance through power struggles.
interpretation.house_meaning: 12th house – unconscious, secrets, solitude, losses, institutions.
interpretation.combined: Deep psychological transformation occurring in private or through therapy. Hidden power dynamics in relationships (especially partnerships) are surfacing. Letting go of control issues in isolation. Powerful dreams.

aspects.note: Beyond 3° orb but close – emotional and loving drives merge; impulses in relationships.

aspects.aspect: square (Gemini-Cancer is 90°, but need exact: 13.54 Gem vs 17.21 Can = difference ~33.67°, not square. Recalc: 13.54 Gem = 73.54° absolute, 17.21 Can = 107.21°, diff 33.67°, no aspect.)
trine (Pisces-Cancer 120°): 14.15 Pisces = 344.15°, 3.016 Cancer = 93.016°, diff 108.87°, orb ~11°, too wide.

aspects.interpretation: Power and transformation aligned with fortune; deep change brings luck.
Sacred devotion to transformation; focused inner work on relationships.

aspects.aspect: opposition (Taurus-Libra 180°): 27.65 Tau = 57.65°, 24.45 Lib = 204.45°, diff 146.8°, not 180. Actually 204.45 - 57.65 = 146.8, close to 150° (quincunx). Or 360-146.8=213.2. Not a major.

aspects.interpretation: Emotional wound around independence activated; healing through direct feeling.
Wider orb, but love and wound merge – relationships trigger healing.

aspects_among_progressed_planets.note: Only exact aspects within 3° are rare here. The closest is Pluto conj Part of Fortune and Vesta. Moon conj Chiron within 1.56° is strong. Other planets are spread across signs.

aspects.interpretation: Moon-Chiron: emotional healing crisis; old partnership wounds surface for release.
Moon opposite Uranus: sudden emotional upsets in relationships; need for freedom clashes with need for security.

progressed_to_natal_aspects_template.message: Natal planet positions (with signs and degrees) are required to compute aspects from progressed planets to natal. Below is a template you can fill with actual natal longitudes (decimal degrees). Once provided, each aspect will be calculated with orbs and interpretations.
progressed_to_natal_aspects_template.example_calculation: If natal Sun were at 15° Aries, progressed Moon at 20.96° Aries would be conjunct (5.96° orb), etc.

interpretive_summary.overall_theme: A period of relationship-driven personal change (Uranus in 1st, Moon and Venus in 7th) combined with career action (Mars in 10th) and deep psychological/financial transformation (Sun in 8th).
interpretive_summary.key_challenges: Neptune fog around money, Saturnine delays in higher learning, Pluto in 12th dredging up hidden power struggles.
interpretive_summary.key_opportunities: Jupiter in 6th for healing work, Uranus on Asc for authentic self-reinvention, Mars in 10th for protective career leadership.
interpretive_summary.likely_external_events: Sudden change in personal appearance or relationship status, a career move involving home/family, financial restructuring (loan, inheritance), spiritual or artistic income source emerging.
interpretive_summary.yearly_progression_theme_2012: Progressed Sun entering 8th house and progressed Uranus entering 1st house marks a year of identity revolution through shared resources and intimacy. Relationships are the mirror for self-discovery.
interpretive_summary.progression_lunar_windows: Around April 25 2012, the progressed Moon at 20° Aries conjoins Chiron and opposes Uranus – a 2-3 day window of emotional intensity, sudden relationship insights, and healing confrontations.

usage_guide.how_to_read_this_JSON: Each progressed planet includes its exact longitude (decimal and DMS), house (based on natal Placidus cusps), and a three-part interpretation (sign, house, combined). The 'aspects_among_progressed_planets' section lists close angular relationships between the progressed positions themselves. The 'progressed_moon_aspects' highlights the fast-moving Moon's triggers. To complete the chart, supply natal planet positions – then all progressed-to-natal aspects can be generated automatically.
usage_guide.next_steps: Provide a list of natal planet longitudes (e.g., 'Sun 20° Aries 15', 'Moon 5° Taurus 40', etc.) and I will output a new JSON with a full aspect grid, including orbs and interpretation for each progressed-to-natal aspect. You can also request transits for the same date.
